verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among its general features, alongside an agent mode and Agent clusters. That is a first-party sign that users can set up recurring automations. However, it appears only as a one-line index entry, and the Kimi Code agent docs describe autonomous task completion inside an interactive conversation rather than unattended background runs. missing for 10: documentation of how scheduled or background automations are configured, triggered and run unattended; their limits; and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
